claim: On v3 denoising-dirty-documents, aggregator=haiku (with coder=sonnet and rest=haiku) PRODUCES a valid submission, unlike detecting-insults where every non-opus-coder routing fails the schema gate. This confirms the schema-gate difference is task-specific: denoising's image-per-file submission format tolerates haiku aggregator; detecting's tabular CSV format does not. X213 score=0.169 (no medal) at $8.13 is the third data point on denoising mixed routing — the X203 silver result is now firmly classified as a single-run outlier (n=3: silver 0.018, none 0.193, none 0.169). Mean score 0.127 is above silver threshold 0.026 but variance dominates.

implications.insight: Schema-gate is task-specific; denoising tolerates haiku-aggregator unlike detecting. Variance on denoising precludes promoting any mixed routing to policy.
